from datetime import datetime

file_path = '/mnt/data/spreadsheet/9726/1_9726_init.xlsx'
df = pd.read_excel(file_path)

# Table 1: Col A (Student ID), Col C (Visit date)
# Table 2: Col H (Student ID.1), Col I (Submission date), Col J (Visit date.1)
# Target: J2 (row 2, col 10)

# Identify the student and submission date for the row corresponding to J2 (df index 0)
student_id_t2 = df.loc[0, 'Student ID.1']
submission_date_t2 = df.loc[0, 'Submission date']

# Filter Table 1 for this student
student_visits = df[df['Student ID'] == student_id_t2][['Visit date']]

# Convert to datetime
student_visits['Visit date'] = pd.to_datetime(student_visits['Visit date'])
submission_date_t2 = pd.to_datetime(submission_date_t2)

# Find visit dates strictly prior to the submission date
prior_visits = student_visits[student_visits['Visit date'] < submission_date_t2]

# Get the most recent one (the maximum date among those prior)
if not prior_visits.empty:
    result_date = prior_visits['Visit date'].max()
else:
    result_date = None

# Write the result to J2 using openpyxl
wb = load_workbook(file_path)
ws = wb.active

if result_date is not None:
    # Convert pandas timestamp to python datetime
    final_val = result_date.to_pydatetime()
    ws.cell(row=2, column=10).value = final_val
else:
    ws.cell(row=2, column=10).value = None

# Save the workbook
output_path = '/mnt/data/outputs/9726_0_f0a9823b/1_9726_output.xlsx'
wb.save(output_path)",
